title: Warp wordmark
description: A plain wordmark: a small solid icon tile and a lowercase name in the geometric display face, set tight. Optional icon-only form for footers.
notes: the icon is any lucide icon (a terminal-ish one by default); never the original's logo shape
name: warp-mark

props.name: name
props.description: the company name, shown in lowercase

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: show only the icon (the name stays for screen readers)
